verdict.rationale: Cua documents a first-party SDK in Python, TypeScript and Rust for creating and driving computers from your own code. It streams sessions back so your app's users can watch or take over, which directly supports embedding device control. The one hands-on report hit a Computer API Server WebSocket connection failure on an early version (0.1.29). That lowers confidence but does not contradict the SDK's existence. Missing for 10: detailed SDK API reference evidence, a published HTTP/OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and successful independent hands-on corroboration of embedding.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed device control in my own application through a documented SDK or API
